requirements.title: NULL MOLD restrictions and admitted states
requirements.definition: MOLD shall be a pointer or allocatable entity, including any type or procedure pointer; pointer MOLD may have any pointer association status, allocatable MOLD may have either allocation status, and MOLD need not be defined with a value.

pending.NULL-MOLD-pointer-or-allocatable: Positive source controls call NULL with pointer and allocatable MOLD actuals; source-control mutation uses a nonpointer nonallocatable MOLD and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.NULL-MOLD-any-type-or-procedure-pointer: Positive controls use integer, real, character, derived-type, and procedure-pointer MOLD actuals; source-control mutation removes one admitted type family from the generator matrix.
pending.NULL-pointer-MOLD-any-association-status: Positive controls call NULL with associated and disassociated pointer MOLD actuals without referencing target values; mutation rejects one association state and the control matrix fails source review.
pending.NULL-allocatable-MOLD-any-allocation-sta: Positive controls call NULL with allocated and unallocated allocatable MOLD actuals without reading allocatable values; mutation rejects one allocation state and the control matrix fails source review.
pending.NULL-MOLD-value-not-required: Positive control uses an undefined pointer or unallocated allocatable MOLD solely for characteristics; the fixture observes only association or allocation status of the result, and mutation reads MOLD value so the control becomes invalid.

requirements.title: NULL MOLD-present result characteristics
requirements.definition: With MOLD present, the NULL result has the same characteristics as MOLD, and deferred type parameters of MOLD remain deferred in the result.

pending.NULL-MOLD-present-same-characteristics: Use pointer and allocatable MOLD actuals with scalar, array, character, and procedure-pointer characteristics; assert contextual assignment accepts the result and selected RANK/KIND/LEN properties match MOLD, with mutations changing MOLD rank or kind.
pending.NULL-MOLD-deferred-type-parameters-defer: Use a character pointer or allocatable with deferred length as MOLD in a context accepting deferred length; assert the NULL result can initialize/disassociate the contextual entity without fixing a length, and mutate to a fixed-length MOLD so LEN-sensitive context checks fail.

requirements.title: NULL contextual characteristics and MOLD absence restrictions
requirements.definition: With MOLD absent, NULL result characteristics come from the allowed context in Table 16.5; MOLD absence is prohibited elsewhere, contextual deferred type parameters remain deferred, and assumed type parameters require MOLD.

pending.NULL-contextual-characteristics-from-tab: Exercise each Table 16.5 context with scalar and array pointer entities, default-initialized components, structure constructors, actual arguments, DATA statements, and pointer assignment; assert ASSOCIATED is false or ALLOCATED is false as applicable, with mutations swapping context rank or type.
pending.NULL-MOLD-absent-only-listed-contexts: Positive source controls use only Table 16.5 contexts for bare NULL(); source-control mutation places bare NULL() in an unlisted expression context and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.NULL-contextual-deferred-type-parameters: Use bare NULL() in a contextual character pointer or allocatable component with deferred length; assert disassociation or unallocation without reading length, and mutate to a fixed-length context for source-control discrimination.
pending.NULL-assumed-type-parameters-require-MOL: Positive source control supplies MOLD for a context with assumed type parameters; source-control mutation omits MOLD and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: NULL MOLD requirements for generic and assumed-rank actual arguments
requirements.definition: For NULL as an actual argument, MOLD is required where type, type parameters, or rank are needed to resolve a generic reference, and is required for an assumed-rank dummy argument.

pending.NULL-generic-resolution-MOLD-required: Positive source control calls a generic with NULL(MOLD=typed_pointer) to select the intended specific procedure; source-control mutation omits MOLD in an ambiguous generic actual and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.NULL-assumed-rank-actual-MOLD-required: Positive source control passes NULL(MOLD=array_pointer) to an assumed-rank dummy; source-control mutation omits MOLD and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.title: NULL result is disassociated or unallocated
requirements.definition: The NULL result is a disassociated pointer or an unallocated allocatable entity.

pending.NULL-pointer-result-disassociated: First associate a pointer with a target and prove ASSOCIATED(pointer) is true; assign pointer=>NULL() or initialize with NULL(), then assert ASSOCIATED(pointer) is false. Mutation removes the NULL assignment so the positive prestate remains.
pending.NULL-allocatable-result-unallocated: First allocate an allocatable component or entity with sentinel contents and prove ALLOCATED is true; assign or construct from NULL() in an allocatable context, then assert ALLOCATED is false without reading contents. Mutation removes the NULL effect so the positive prestate remains.
